name: War Cry
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 3, bloodrager 3, lathspell 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Area cone-shaped emanation
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You unleash a battlecry that causes all creatures within the cone to cower in fear for 1d4 rounds. Any creature that fails their Fortitude save loses their Dexterity bonus to AC and is dazed.
